title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit-logging enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforces KMS region pinning at the RBAC v2 layer and enriches audit logs with key residency fields. Backwards-compatible rollout behind feature flag. No expected customer-facing API changes; introduces new admin controls and audit schema for compliance teams.
description: Motivation: Customers with strict data residency requirements have asked for RBAC-level enforcement of KMS key region residency so that keys bound to a region cannot be used from incompatible regions. This PR implements enforcement hooks in the RBAC v2 policy enforcer, adds audit logging fields to capture key_residency and resolved_kms_region, and wires KMS metadata checks into the permission decision flow. Summary of changes: 1) RBAC enforcer: new policy predicate 'kms_region_residency' and enforcement path that validates encryption key metadata against request routing region. 2) Audit logging: audit record schema extended with key_residency, kms_key_id, resolved_kms_region, and enforcement_outcome. Logs are emitted for allow/deny decisions and for fallback events. 3) KMS integration: metadata fetch caching and grace-period logic for cross-region key rotation. 4) Config/flags: feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' (opt-in for canary) and rollout plan annotated in docs. 5) Tests and infra: unit tests for predicates, integration tests against local KMS emulator, added policy fixtures, and observability dashboards/alerts. Backwards compatibility: enforcement is opt-in; when disabled the enforcer will emit audit-only records. Migration: a backfill job is included to annotate existing audit logs with resolved_kms_region where possible. Rollout plan: canary on Dedicated for a week, enable for 10% of hosted traffic, monitor audits/denies then complete global rollout. Related linear/jira: ENG-5421, SEC-310, SUP-1023. Technical notes: caching reduces additional latency to ~1ms per request after warm cache; added metrics rbac.kms_residency.checks and rbac.kms_residency.denies for tracking. Operational runbook and dashboard links included in PR comments.
